displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 single-stage furnace in IOG-2037B (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide): EAS
meaning: R-32 sensor fault: heating stops and only the fan runs while the furnace is in mitigation mode.
causes: R-32 sensor fault while the furnace is in mitigation mode
diySteps: Write down EAS. Heat is off and the fan can still be running
Technician: the chart says to investigate the R-32 sensor and replace it
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. EAS is the sensor-fault mitigation code, not the leak code EAL and not the lost-communication code EAF.
